intro: Monkey Knowledge is the permanent upgrade system that opens at player level 30. Each point costs a Knowledge Point; deeper points also need a number of points already spent in the same tree and a one-time Monkey Money payment. It is switched off in CHIMPS and by some challenge rules.
respec: Respec costs 2,000 Monkey Money and refunds every Knowledge Point; Monkey Money already paid stays paid, so re-buying a point later only costs the Knowledge Point. Each point can also be switched off on its own for free.
